question.knowledge_point: Graphing a Stretched Negative Reciprocal Function
question.problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=-\frac{3}{4x}?$
question.worked_solution:
To plot $y=-\frac{3}{4x},$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=-\frac{1}{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/d5d93e12275c683e0a56f0ec9a0c99540a7774879cd0f8fa69151ddba68a44fa.png)

- Stretch the result by a scale factor of $\frac{3}{4}$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=-\frac{3}{4x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/76d779da22082439eb40586ddbeb325368b1f49f15fef3158ebaa0eee90f4d84.png)
